title: Pianist sisters and a musician's illness
summary: Barker and the interviewer try to work out the wives of two musicians, pianist sisters from across the lake, and one musician's sickness.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
